two_world_identical_observable_law: X is constant; P(z=+1)=P(z=-1)=1/2; P(scale=1)=P(scale=4)=1/2. Scale is omitted from the model input.
scale_input_boundary: Adding scale distinguishes the atoms; an ordinary conditional regressor can then fit these noiseless worlds. No renewal model is needed.

markov_additive_transform.novelty: Standard finite Markov additive / reward algebra, not a new transform method

limitations: The worlds are constructed counterexamples, not evidence about any approved market.
The transform is exact only for the specified finite state model with its current context fixed or otherwise explicitly propagated.
Age-dependent nonzero conditional means can be fit by ordinary state/hurdle regressions; this example gives no neural novelty claim.
